data.name: Club Regina Puerto Vallarta managed by Accor
data.address: Av. Paseo de la Marina Sur 205, Marina Vallarta, 48335 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
Set on a peninsula between the Pacific Ocean and a marina, this relaxed beach resort is 2.7 km from Aeropuerto Internacional de Puerto Vallarta airport and 9 km from the Malecón boardwalk.
Featuring beach-inspired decor and cedar furnishings, the casual rooms offer Wi-Fi access, flat-screen TVs and safes. Some add balconies with hot tubs; upgraded rooms and 1- to 2-bedroom suites include pull-out sofas and kitchenettes. Room service is available.
Amenities include an international restaurant and 2 bars, along with outdoor pools. Guests have access to an adjacent property's fitness and spa facilities (fee), and parking is complimentary.
